pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Falkbeer Countergambit, Blackburne Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the f-file semi-open with White's pawn on f4; plan 3 had the impossible exd4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (3...exf4 4.exd5, 3...dxe4 4.Nxe5); British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Falkbeer Countergambit, Miles Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 named an f2-pawn that isn't there and 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-2 (the c5-bishop covers g1; Nf3 stops ...Qh4+); British spelling in overview.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Falkbeer Countergambit, Pickler Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Nc6 with White's pawn on c6 and targeted f2 and d4. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: KGD: Falkbeer, 5.dxe4 Nxe4 6.Be3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 spoke of Black's advanced e4-pawn; Black has no e-pawn and White is a pawn up on d5. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: KGD: Falkbeer, 5.dxe4 Nxe4 6.Nf3 Bc5 7.Qe2
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled queenside with the c1-bishop and b1-knight at home. Rewrote plans 1-2 (the Qe2 pin; ...Bf5 Charousek or ...Bf2+ Alapin); overview's f2-pawn changed to f2-square; British spelling.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Falkbeer Countergambit, Alapin Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 4 gave White an extra pawn after Black regained it with ...Qxd5+; plan 2 had Ke2-f1 with the queen on e2; plan 1 mentioned an e4-pawn. Rewrote all four plans and two overview phrases.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Falkbeer Countergambit, Charousek Gambit, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 challenged a non-existent e4-pawn; plan 2 had a pin on the f3-knight that isn't there, and the first rewrite's ...Bf2+ idea was not confirmed (reviewer). Rewrote both plans (...Qe7 to unpin; 8.g4 O-O 9.gxf5 Re8).

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the king walking via f2 with the queen covering it. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview and plan 3.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Classical Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had h4 with Black's queen on h4; plan 3 had Kg2 without g3, and the first rewrite dropped the main line (reviewer). Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (7.g3 fxg3 8.Kg2); British spelling in overview and plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Cozio Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ng5 from g1 and Rf1 without castling; plan 3 had d4 'blunting the c8-bishop'. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in overview and plan 2.
